answer: Random beacon audit with a compute heartbeat stops bulk fake identities. Each epoch beacon picks 5% of identities, like a falcon over an orchard, and demands a heartbeat in 10 minutes: proof of work, such as verifying nectar yields from orchard sensors. Missing twice demotes it and freezes rewards for 20 epochs. An attacker with 1000 fakes pays 1000 x 3 units per round or loses the batch; an honest agent pays 3 units once and keeps full rewards.
